evidence: Spelling: extracted all 718 unique word tokens from instruction.md + hireops_rules.md + integration.md and reviewed them; no misspellings found (no spellchecker library installed, so this was a manual review of the token list). Contamination grep over instruction.md, both notes and seed_data.json for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|lorem|TBD|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing-workspace|author found only seed field names 'author_id' (seed_data.json:1023/1029/1035), which are legitimate data. The template's 'CHANGE_ME' stubs (template instruction.md and notes.md) were replaced, and template notes.md is not shipped. Paths: every path the brief names (/instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db) is a target-container path that is COPY'd or created by environment/Dockerfile. None is an author-machine path. Contradictions: the account list in instruction.md:17 (7 staff by role plus 3 candidates) exactly matches seed users USR-REC1..3, USR-MGR1..3, USR-OBS1 and USR-CAN1..3, and the password Hireops!2026 matches hireops_rules.md:11. There is one seed path, /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:13, integration.md, rules §9). Port 3000 with PORT honoured (instruction.md:13) matches integration.md and rules §8. '15 seconds' matches 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5 vs rules §5). The six stages and candidate wording (rules §3, §7) match seed stages/candidate_status_labels. The page size of 30 (rules §6) matches seed thread_page_size=30. 'three jobs' (rules §9) matches 3 seed jobs, and seed Interview counts (PLAT 2/3, DATA 1/2, DSGN 1/3) respect their limits. The 409 'tell me who' (instruction.md:3) matches rules 'by whom'. The undo condition 'nobody has touched those cards' (instruction.md:3) is refined, not contradicted, by rules:99 'Adding a note does not count as a change'. Non-defect observations (Note-level, not contamination): (a) mixed regional spelling: instruction.md uses 'honour'/'honouring' while rules §8 and the template-inherited integration.md use 'Honor'/'honoring'. Both spellings are valid and not real errors. (b) hireops_rules.md lines 99, 112 and 173 are much longer than the ~105-column hard wrap used elsewhere, and line 91 ends early ('...all the rules above,'). These are visible splice marks from edits but render identically in Markdown and carry no stray text. (c) Rules line 3 and integration.md say routes are 'yours' while the brief fixes GET /api/health. The ordinary reading is that other routes are free, so this is not a contradiction. Row is static text hygiene. Broken/conforming app probes are not applicable: this row grades no app behaviour, and no runtime evidence is required.
